user.title: FX Luminaire Luxor
user.description: The controller's address on your network. It speaks plain HTTP on port 80.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Luxor controller at that address.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.

init.title: Luxor options
init.description: Colour is stored in a theme, not on the group, so a colour set here survives the controller's own schedule. Choose which theme it is written to.

data.colour_theme: Theme index that colour changes are written to

slot_table_stale.title: Luxor colour writing is disabled
slot_table_stale.description: {count} palette-slot claim(s) no longer match the controller, so a slot may now belong to a different light group than the one that claimed it. Colour changes are refused until this is resolved. Details: {detail}

save_to_theme.name: Save to theme
save_to_theme.description: Write a light's current brightness and colour into a Luxor theme so they persist. Both are otherwise temporary: a theme stores its own per-group intensity and colour and re-applies both whenever it runs.

theme_index.name: Theme
theme_index.description: Which theme to write to. Defaults to the theme set in the integration's options. Choose deliberately: the alarm themes are themes too.
